{{Top|leg}}
'''Canines''' were a subgroup of mammals. [[Sentience/Legends|Sentient]] canine species included the [[Amaran/Legends|Amarans]],<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> [[Codru-Ji]],<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Geelan]],<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> [[Gurlanin]]s,<ref name="Republic Commando: Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]],<ref name="AE" /> [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanians]],<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Ranth]],<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]],<ref name="NEGAS" /> [[Yapi]],<ref name="Endgame">''[[Endgame]]''</ref> and an [[unidentified Lupine species]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 8">[[Knights of the Old Republic 8|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 8]]</ref>
